description: NLP extraction evaluation cases for the AI-Based Symptom Checker. Each case contains a realistic user input and the expected canonical symptoms, severity, duration and onset that the extraction pipeline should produce. Severity uses MILD / MODERATE / SEVERE or is omitted when not mentioned. Duration and onset are optional free-text fields that the extractor should normalize.

cases.input: I've had a really bad headache and feel like throwing up since yesterday
cases.notes: Tests 'bad headache' → severity SEVERE, 'throwing up' → nausea, 'since yesterday' → 1 day

cases.input: my throat hurts and I have a runny nose, been sneezing all day
cases.notes: Tests multiple ENT symptoms from a common cold description

cases.input: I have fever with chills and my whole body is aching for the past 3 days
cases.notes: Tests typical flu/dengue presentation with duration

cases.input: mujhe bahut tez bukhar hai aur pet me dard ho raha hai
cases.notes: Tests Hinglish input: 'tez bukhar' → fever SEVERE, 'pet me dard' → abdominal_pain

cases.input: chest pain that goes to my left arm and I'm sweating a lot
cases.notes: Tests cardiac emergency pattern — red flag combination

cases.input: I have been coughing for about 2 weeks and noticed some blood in the mucus today
cases.notes: Tests TB-suspicious presentation; 'blood in the mucus' → coughing_blood

cases.input: My skin has been really itchy with a circular red patch on my arm, it looks like a ring
cases.notes: Tests dermatological description of ringworm; 'ring' → ring_shaped_rash

cases.input: feeling dizzy and tired all the time, also my skin looks pale lately
cases.notes: Tests anaemia presentation with lay terms 'dizzy', 'tired', 'pale'

cases.input: burns when I pee and I need to go to the bathroom every hour, lower belly also hurts
cases.notes: Tests UTI presentation; 'burns when I pee' → burning_urination

cases.input: I have acidity and a sour taste keeps coming up in my mouth especially after eating
cases.notes: Tests GERD; 'acidity' → heartburn, 'sour taste coming up' → acid_regurgitation

cases.input: severe stomach pain on the right side near my hip, I also feel nauseous
cases.notes: Tests appendicitis presentation; 'right side near my hip' → lower_right_abdominal_pain

cases.input: my eyes are red and sticky, there's yellowish gunk in the morning
cases.notes: Tests conjunctivitis; 'sticky' + 'yellowish gunk' → eye_discharge

cases.input: I can't breathe properly and there's a whistling sound when I exhale
cases.notes: Tests asthma; 'can't breathe properly' → shortness_of_breath, 'whistling sound' → wheezing

cases.input: I got lots of small itchy bumps between my fingers, they're worse at night
cases.notes: Tests scabies description; 'small itchy bumps' as primary symptom. Night worsening is a temporal detail, not a separate symptom.

cases.input: woke up with the worst headache of my life, it came on suddenly
cases.notes: Tests thunderclap headache red flag; 'worst headache of my life' + 'suddenly' → sudden_severe_headache

cases.input: loose motions for 2 days, can't keep water down, feeling very weak
cases.notes: Tests gastroenteritis with dehydration risk; 'loose motions' → diarrhea, 'can't keep water down' → unable_to_keep_fluids_down

cases.input: high fever since 4 days with pain behind my eyes and joints are hurting badly
cases.notes: Tests dengue presentation; 'high fever' → SEVERE, 'hurting badly' → SEVERE

cases.input: my nose is completely blocked, face feels like pressure around cheeks and forehead, thick green mucus
cases.notes: Tests sinusitis; 'blocked' → nasal_congestion, 'pressure around cheeks and forehead' → facial_pain_or_pressure

cases.input: I'm peeing a lot more than usual and always feel thirsty, also lost some weight recently
cases.notes: Tests diabetes presentation; classic triad of polyuria, polydipsia, weight loss

cases.input: kamar me bahut dard hai, 1 hafte se chal raha hai, jhukne me dikkat hoti hai
cases.notes: Tests Hinglish input: 'kamar me bahut dard' → lower_back_pain SEVERE, 'jhukne me dikkat' → muscle_stiffness
